# Julie's session stickies
Colorful, session-specific sticky cards beside your DeepSeek Harness conversation. Capture notes wit
hout interrupting your chat, then optionally authorize selected notes as sequential agent follow-ups
out interrupting your chat, then optionally authorize selected notes as sequential agent follow-ups.
## Features
- Multiple named, resizable cards per session, with editable checklists, bullets, numbering, text an

d colors.
- Notes persist per session; browser-local drafts and card sizes stay on the current brows

er.
- Collapse the board when you need more space. Use ⌘⌥⇧N on macOS or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N on Windows

while the expanded board is focused in the current view.
- Auto run is opt-in: choose notes and **An
swer only** or **Execute**, then explicitly run the queue. Ordinary notes and agent tools cannot aut
* or **Execute**, then explicitly run the queue. Ordinary notes and agent tools cannot authorize it.
## Installation
This plugin targets the DeepSeek Harness desktop/web profile with protocol version `0.2.2-rc.1`. Ins
tall the GitHub bundle from Plugin Manager using `github:juliiiiiiiu/julies-session-stickies`. A pag
e refresh may be needed after activation. GitHub installs can require build permission according to
your package manager's policy; inspect the source before allowing it.
The plugin displays beside conversations. Its dog button collapses or expands the board. Enter commi
ts a new note, and Shift+Enter inserts a line break. The card title can be edited directly.
## Safety and storage
Cards and committed notes are stored by the DSH host per session. Drafts, local recovery journals an
d card sizes are stored in browser-local storage. Clearing browser data may remove those browser-loc
al values. Back up important information before removing storage or changing profiles.
Auto run uses a queue shared across the session. Execute mode uses the current session's permissions
; Answer only uses a read-only tool allowlist. Pausing prevents subsequent queue items but does not
stop an item already running. Review selected notes and permissions before authorizing them. On rest
art the plugin pauses uncertain work rather than replaying it automatically.
## Development
Requires Node.js and the host services provided by a compatible DeepSeek Harness installation. The g
enerated client is committed, so consumers do not need to build it.
